title: Warning against error and an exhortation to grow in grace
description: Peter concludes the letter by urging readers to be without blemish and blameless, counting the Lord's patience as salvation. He refers to Paul's letters which contain things that are hard to understand, which the unlearned distort to their own destruction. Readers are warned not to be carried away by the error of the lawless and are encouraged to grow in grace and knowledge of Jesus Christ.
